description: Batched migration/refactor path: discover call sites, run minimal exemplar end-to-end, then iterate batches each in an isolated worktree with a regression gate before merging. Behavior preservation is enforced throughout.

steps.label: discover
steps.description: Enumerate all in-scope migration points (call sites, files, patterns). Produce a ranked list artifact. No edits.

steps.label: minimal-exemplar
steps.description: Pick the smallest representative migration point. Migrate it in an isolated worktree, run full regression suite, commit as precedent. This commit is the reference template for all subsequent batches.
steps.exemplar_selection: Pick the minimal exemplar that still covers ALL transformation patterns in scope — smallest is not the goal by itself; coverage-per-line is. Judge candidates on four dimensions: (1) pattern coverage — does the candidate exercise every transformation pattern the migration will apply? (2) file size — prefer the smallest file/diff that still satisfies (1); (3) dependency fan-out — prefer low fan-out so regression failures localize to the migration itself; (4) test coverage — prefer a call site already covered by tests so behavior preservation is verifiable, not asserted.

steps.label: exemplar-gate
steps.description: Audit the exemplar diff for behavior changes, weakened test assertions, and scope creep. Block if any blocker-severity finding exists.

steps.label: batch-loop
steps.description: For each batch: create isolated worktree, execute migration for that batch's call sites only, run regression (compile + tests + lint + artifact diff), write regression-output artifact and diff-summary artifact. Batch is complete only when regression exits 0 and both artifacts are written. On any regression failure: stop, repair or rollback this batch. Do not proceed to next batch while any batch is red.

steps.label: batch-diff-audit
steps.description: After each batch passes regression: audit the batch diff for behavioral changes, unmigrated call sites, weakened/deleted test assertions, and out-of-scope edits. Run both profiles. Block on any high/critical finding.

steps.label: semantic-equivalence-spot-check
steps.description: For batches touching public API or core logic: run a semantic-equivalence profile from a different model family than the host. Host picks by family: claude host -> codex-semantic-equivalence-v1, codex host -> claude-semantic-equivalence-v1. Both profiles share the same prompt and are static data; the profile itself contains zero runtime logic. Judge must read both before and after versions of key files directly; must not infer from diff alone.

steps.label: merge
steps.description: Merge each passing batch worktree branch into integration branch. On conflict: stop immediately, do not cascade to remaining batches. The scheduler only STOPS on conflict — it never rolls back automatically; rollback is executed by the host following on_conflict_rollback in order. git push always requires human confirmation.
on_conflict_rollback: 1. Preserve the scene: do NOT delete the worktree. Register rollback-artifact.json recording the worktree path and the conflict diff.
2. If mid-merge: `git merge --abort` (or `git rebase --abort` if mid-rebase).

3. Host decision: either rebase the batch branch and retry, or abandon the batch (`git worktree remove --force <path>` + `git branch -D <batch-branch>` — execute only AFTER the abandon decision is recorded as an artifact).
4. No cascade: batches after the conflicting batch do not continue automatically.

steps.label: closeout
steps.description: Run full regression on integration branch. Write final migration summary: batches completed, call sites migrated, any residual findings, artifact evidence index.

stop_conditions: any batch regression gate fails: stop that batch, repair or rollback before proceeding
any high/critical finding from diff audit: block merge until resolved
merge conflict detected: stop immediately, do not cascade to remaining batches
git push always requires human confirmation
test assertion weakened or deleted: treat as migration error, fix migration not the test
out-of-scope file in batch diff: flag as scope creep, revert that edit
progress evidence required: regression command output + diff summary artifact must exist before batch is marked complete
agent self-report alone is not accepted as completion evidence
notes: worktree_exec handles write isolation; plugin profiles only audit the resulting diffs in read-only mode
plugin cannot grant write permission; PermissionPolicy on the host run controls execution sandbox
exemplar commit is the reference template; subsequent batch agents should receive it as context
